evidence.quote: The expected duration for completing the course is 3 years.
Lectures, seminars, and laboratory sessions are taught in English.

Se sei un candidato extracomunitario che necessita di un VISTO PER MOTIVI DI STUDIO, devi inoltre seguire le procedure di candidatura che verranno stabilite dal Ministero dell'Università e della Ricerca per l'ingresso, la residenza e l'iscrizione agli istituti di istruzione superiore per gli studenti che richiedono visti per i corsi di istruzione superiore in Italia, inviando la richiesta di pre-iscrizione tramite Universitaly (www.universitaly.it).

notes: Tuition: no fee for this programme could be extracted. The contribution regulation (https://web.poliba.it/sites/default/files/didattica/regolamento_contribuzione_studentesca_politecnico_di_bari_25_26.pdf) is an institution-wide ISEE-band table for A.A. 2025/2026; no quote states one lowest and one highest fee applying to a non-EU applicant whose household is abroad, and no quote ties Morocco to a country group or this programme to a fee group. Programme page lists a maximum of 50 places for "Management Engineering for Innovation (English)". Intakes: no intake with a dated deadline for non-EU applicants was found; the CEnT guide lists competition windows for all applicants (e.g. 1st early session from 03.02.2026 to 25.06.2026) without stating they are for non-EU applicants, so no intake is given. More rounds exist for the CEnT/TOLC-I competition.

note.fr: L'admission est subordonnée à la réussite du test CEnT ou du TOLC-I (score minimum 18/50 pour la session précoce, 12/50 pour les autres sessions).
note.en: Admission is subject to passing the CEnT or TOLC-I test (minimum score 18/50 for the early session, 12/50 for the other sessions).

evidence.quote: Admission is subject to passing the CEnT (CISIA English Test) or the TOLC-I (CISIA Online Test for Engineering)
Il punteggio minimo per essere ammessi è di 18/50 per le prove della sessione anticipata mentre scende a 12/50 per le prove della sessione standard e straordinaria.

note.fr: Pour les candidats non-UE nécessitant un visa d'études, une pré-inscription sur le portail Universitaly est requise.
note.en: For non-EU candidates needing a study visa, a pre-enrolment on the Universitaly portal is required.
